representative.title: Jagex announces new RuneScape MMO "RS4", set years away from launch
representative.summary: Jagex unveiled RS4, a new Unreal Engine-based MMORPG set in the RuneScape universe that will sit alongside (not replace) existing RuneScape games; it begins in a region called Ashenfall and is said to be "still a few years away" from launch, with platforms not yet announced.

representative.title: Activision and Bethesda issue cease-and-desist notices over AI-generated Fallout and Modern Warfare 2 fan projects
representative.summary: Activision and Bethesda sent legal cease-and-desist notices against two fan projects built with AI coding agents — a full AI-recreated "Fallout: New York" and an AI-assisted Modern Warfare 2 decompilation — and both creators took their projects down after receiving the threats.

representative.title: Banjo-Kazooie PC port "decomp" developer calls AI-generated game ports "a race to the bottom"
representative.summary: DarioSamo, developer of the fan-made Banjo-Kazooie PC decompilation port, criticized newly-surfaced AI-generated ports of classic games as "a race to the bottom" and disrespectful to the human engineering work behind renderers and frameworks, clarifying his team has no connection to a recent AI-generated Banjo-Tooie port and maintains a strict no-AI policy.

representative.title: Capcom details plans to evolve its RE Engine into an "AI game engine" under new REX initiative
representative.summary: Capcom outlined its REX initiative to evolve the RE Engine toward an "AI game engine" that can help automatically generate code and run test plays, aiming for AI to "unleash the potential of creators" rather than generate art independently; some underlying tech will reportedly be made publicly available for AI training. Note: AI-centric story that may overlap with the digest's AI-focused sections.

representative.title: Another high-profile PSN account hacked via social engineering, renewing PlayStation security concerns
representative.summary: A prominent PlayStation Network account was compromised through social engineering, the latest in a string of such incidents in 2026; the report says attackers were able to get PlayStation support to grant account access using only a PSN username, associated email, and basic purchase/transaction details. Single-outlet report at time of writing.

representative.title: PlatinumGames suggests more Bayonetta is coming despite exodus of lead developers
representative.summary: PlatinumGames CEO Atsushi Inaba indicated the Bayonetta series will continue despite the departure of several of the franchise's lead directors and creators in recent years; also reported same day by Nintendo Life.

representative.title: Final Fantasy 7 Remake trilogy director Hamaguchi: keeping the plot intact "wasn't easy"
representative.summary: Naoki Hamaguchi, director of the FF7 Remake trilogy's finale "Final Fantasy VII Revelation," said it was "absolutely essential" but difficult to preserve the original story's intent without the remake becoming his own personal fan project; also covered same day by Kotaku.

representative.summary: The director of Final Fantasy VII Revelation said he personally pushed internally for the game to get a physical release option, saying "I did my best" to advocate for it.

representative.title: Digital Foundry delivers its tech verdict on The Witcher 3 Remastered for Switch 2
representative.summary: Digital Foundry's technical analysis called the Switch 2 version of The Witcher 3 Remastered "a colossal upgrade" over the original Switch release and said it's easy to recommend for Switch 2 owners.
